equation_id.description:
Shared engine for the arithmetic pair-match game family (multiplication,
addition, …). Every game has an identical structure — ArithmeticConstants::LEVEL_COUNT
levels, level N being ArithmeticConstants::FACTS_PER_LEVEL facts of the form
`N ∘ b` — so all read and check logic lives here. A concrete game supplies
only the operation via symbol(), apply() and levelTitle(); content is
deterministic, so there are no tables, item models or admin screens.

Admin.FindTheWrong.StoreItemRequest.title: Admin Store FindTheWrong Item Request
Admin.FindTheWrong.StoreItemRequest.description: JSON payload for creating a new polygon item under a level.

polygon.description: Ordered list of [x, y] points in 0..1 coordinates. Minimum 3 points.

name.description: Localized item name. All three locales are required (used by TTS).

explanation.description: Optional localized explanation shown after the item is found. Locales are independent — send only those you have.

Admin.FindTheWrong.UpdateItemRequest.title: Admin Update FindTheWrong Item Request
Admin.FindTheWrong.UpdateItemRequest.description: JSON payload for partially updating an item.

polygon.description: Full replacement polygon (no partial merge). Same shape rules as create.

name.description: Locale keys to overwrite. Omitted locales are kept as-is.

FindTheWrong.Item.title: FindTheWrong.Item
FindTheWrong.Item.description: Public-facing polygon item without reveal-after-submit fields

polygon.description: Ordered list of [x, y] vertices in normalized 0..1 coordinates

name_audio_url.description: Absolute URL of the name audio for the current locale

title_audio_url.description: Absolute URL of the title audio for the current locale

image_url.description: Absolute URL of the level image

items_count.description: Number of items on the level (present on list endpoint)

id.description:
Reveal-after-submit shape for a find-the-wrong item. Used for both found and
missed items in the submit response — `stars` is included only when set
(found items 1..3); for missed items it's omitted.

`stars` is injected via the second constructor argument so callers can
build the resource per item with the right rating, without contorting
`$this->resource` into a wrapper object.

statement_id.description:
Shared engine for the statement-based true/false games (image + text). They
are mechanically identical and differ only in their backing models, so the
submit flow (validate → score → persist) lives here once. Each game supplies
its own reads and scoring via fetchAllLevels()/fetchLevel()/check(), which
touch the game-specific models.

id.description:
Admin editor shape for a TrueFalseImage level: full title translations, the
cover image URL, per-locale title audio status, and the embedded statements
(each via the shared StatementAdminResource). Used by the single-level read
endpoint; the levels list uses the generic LevelAdminResource.

title_audio_url.description: Audio URL for the level title

id.description:
Admin editor shape for a TrueFalseText level: full title and text
translations, optional cover image URL, per-locale audio status for both the
title and the text body, and the embedded statements.

Admin.RegenerateAudioRequest.title: Admin Regenerate Audio Request
Admin.RegenerateAudioRequest.description: Selects which audio field and locale to regenerate.

field.description:
Body for a per-(field, locale) TTS regeneration request, shared by the level
and statement admin endpoints. Only the surface shape is validated here;
whether the field is a real audio attribute of the target model — and whether
the locale is supported — is the model-aware job of TtsRegenerationService,
which surfaces a 422 for unknown values.

Admin.StoreLevelRequest.title: Admin Store Level Request
Admin.StoreLevelRequest.description: Multipart/form-data payload for creating a new game level.

title.description: Localized level title. All three locales are required.

text.description: Localized body text (TrueFalseText only; required there).

image.description: Cover image (jpeg/png/webp, max 10 MB). Required except for TrueFalseText.

uk.description:
Validates an admin "create statement" request, shared by both true/false
games (the statement shape is identical). `statement` is required in every
locale (it drives TTS); `explanation` is optional and per-locale independent.

Admin.UpdateLevelRequest.title: Admin Update Level Request
Admin.UpdateLevelRequest.description: Multipart/form-data payload for updating an existing game level. Send via POST with _method=PATCH so the file part survives Laravel's form-method spoofing.

title.description: Localized level title. All three locales are required.

text.description: Localized body text (TrueFalseText only; required there).

image.description: Optional replacement cover image (jpeg/png/webp, max 10 MB). Omit to keep the existing one.

uk.description:
Validates an admin "update statement" request, shared by both true/false
games. Same shape as the store request; `is_true` is required so the toggle
always has an explicit value on save.

Admin.Statement.title: Admin Statement
Admin.Statement.description: Admin-side true/false statement with localized text and per-locale audio status.

id.description:
Admin shape for a true/false statement, shared by both games (the statement
form is identical across them). Emits the full translations map for the
editable text fields plus a per-locale `{ url, is_stale }` audio block for
each TTS field, so the form can edit every locale and light up the
regenerate button without recomputing any hash on the client.

Reads are side-effect free: audio status comes from MediaUrlGenerator +
the stored path hash, never from Tts::getOrGenerate.

LevelDescriptionCollection.description:
Player-facing level summary. `progress` is expected to be populated upstream by
LevelProgressService::decorate(); when it is not (e.g. the undecorated
`resources_default` show fallback) the field safely degrades to `not_started`
— i.e. "no progress data known", never a played status.

LevelDescription.title: LevelDescription
LevelDescription.description: Level summary for the player level grid

id.description: Transform the resource into an array.

progress.description: Player's progress from their most recent attempt on this level

has_password.description: False for Google-only accounts; the client uses it to choose the account-deletion confirmation UI.

description.example: Find the incorrect statement among the options.

categories.description: Learning areas the game belongs to (a game may have several).

ValidationErrorResponse.description: Returned on 422 when request validation fails.

errors.description: Map of field name to the list of its validation messages.

duration_seconds: The duration seconds field is required.
